# Results — Study 606 (OPEC Announcement Effect)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The folklore under test —
**OPEC meeting days move oil: vol doubles on decision day, and the post-decision drift is
tradable** — tested on the full hardcoded calendar of **107 OPEC / OPEC+ ministerial
decision days 2000-2026** against three oil tapes (WTI `CL=F`, Brent `BZ=F`, `USO`).
Offline & deterministic once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every
number. As-of **2026-06-30** (the last complete session of the last complete month).
Fingerprints: CL=F `1a2103f8c32a` · BZ=F `7e9543880619` · USO `6976f7deb0d1`.*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Meeting calendar | **107** OPEC Conference + OPEC+ (ONOMM) decision days, 2000-03-28 → 2026-06-07, hardcoded in [`data.py`](../opec_announcement_effect/data.py) from the OPEC press-release archive (scope rule and per-date sources in the file) |
| Real tape | yfinance daily OHLC — `CL=F` 6,490 sessions (2000-08-23→2026-06-30, **105** meetings mapped), `BZ=F` 4,708 (2007-07-30→, **68**), `USO` 5,087 (2006-04-10→, **73**) |
| Event convention | day 0 = first tradable session **at-or-after** the decision date, per asset (weekend ONOMMs roll to Monday); baseline = all sessions further than **±5** from any day 0 |
| Execution / costs | continuation rule: day-0 sign known at the settle (decisions land intraday, hours earlier); enter at the **day-0 close**, exit close(+5) — one documented convention, with an enter-at-close(+1) lag variant shown; **2 / 5 / 10 bps one-way** futures costs |
| Survivorship | none — front-month futures and a live ETF, no panel selection. (JMMC / V8-subgroup calls are **excluded** by the pre-registered scope rule — conservative for the vol claim.) |

## 1) Volatility — decision days ARE louder… by half, not by double

Day-0 |close-to-close return| and intraday range vs the event-free baseline. Bootstrap CI:
events resampled i.i.d., baseline in circular blocks of 10. Placebo: 2,000 seeded random
same-size day sets from the baseline pool.

| tape | n | \|r\| day 0 | \|r\| baseline | **vol multiple** | 95% CI | Welch *t* | BF *t* | placebo *p* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| CL=F | 105 | 248.3 bps | 177.1 bps | **1.40×** | 1.15–1.67 | **+3.07** | +2.84 | 0.018 |
| BZ=F | 68 | 242.2 bps | 158.0 bps | **1.53×** | 1.21–1.89 | **+3.01** | +2.57 | 0.000 |
| USO | 73 | 242.1 bps | 159.8 bps | **1.52×** | 1.20–1.85 | **+3.17** | +3.09 | 0.000 |

Intraday range tells the same story: **1.45× / 1.52× / 1.47×** (Welch *t* = +4.80 / +4.23
/ +3.64). The volatility effect is **real** — it clears *t* ≥ 2 on all three tapes with
placebo *p* ≤ 0.018 — but the folklore's "**doubles**" is not there: the 95% CI **excludes
2.0 on every tape** (upper bounds 1.67 / 1.89 / 1.85). Decision days run ~**1.4–1.5×**
normal, about half the advertised drama.

## 2) Signed drift day 0..+5 — nothing, anywhere

Cumulative close(-1)→close(+k) drift per event; the Signal-axis statistic is the
Newey-West dummy-regression *t* on the daily tape (lags k+5), with the per-event
one-sample *t* beside it.

| k | CL=F cum (HAC *t*) | BZ=F cum (HAC *t*) | USO cum (HAC *t*) |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 0 | −11.2 bps (−0.30) | −0.1 bps (−0.07) | −14.2 bps (−0.36) |
| 1 | −50.3 bps (−0.92) | −65.2 bps (−1.15) | −57.3 bps (−0.90) |
| 2 | −20.5 bps (−0.16) | −47.2 bps (−0.70) | −39.3 bps (−0.46) |
| 3 | +16.6 bps (+0.51) | −35.9 bps (−0.44) | −37.7 bps (−0.34) |
| 5 | −215.4 bps (−0.89) | −50.0 bps (−0.63) | −31.5 bps (−0.16) |

Fifteen horizon×tape cells, **every |t| < 1.2**. There is no signed post-decision drift:
the big day-0 variance is two-sided (cuts rally, collapses crash) and averages to noise.

## 3) Surprise continuation — the "trade the announcement" rule is a 2020 artifact

Go with the day-0 sign, hold to close(+5). Gross per event, one-sample *t*:

| tape | all events | ex-2020 | pre-2016 | 2016+ |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| CL=F | +365.0 bps (*t* = 1.40) | +67.2 (*t* = 1.29) | +69.9 (*t* = 0.95) | +774.2 (*t* = 1.27) |
| BZ=F | +136.2 bps (*t* = 1.69) | +111.5 (*t* = 1.62) | +120.2 (*t* = 0.87) | +145.0 (*t* = 1.45) |
| USO | +158.1 bps (*t* = 2.20) | **+70.7 (*t* = 1.19)** | +75.2 (*t* = 0.68) | +212.7 (*t* = 2.25) |

The only cell that grazes the bar (USO, *t* = 2.20) **collapses to *t* = 1.19 once the
five 2020 meetings are removed** — the price-war/9.7-mb/d storm carries it. The
one-day-lagged entry (close(+1)) reads *t* = +1.40 / +0.58 / +1.91. Hit rates 56–61%.
Costs are not the problem — at 2/5/10 bps one-way the CL net is +361.0/+355.0/+345.0 bps
per event — **significance is**: a mean that needs five 2020 outliers is not a signal,
and the desk does not stamp it.

## Synthetic machinery control — the detectors are faithful

Deterministic world, meetings every ~63 sessions, planted meeting-day effects
(seed 606; a machinery proof, never cited in support of a stamp):

| planted world | vol multiple | Welch *t* | placebo *p* | day-0 drift (HAC *t*) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| null (×1, drift 0) | 0.96× | −0.51 | 0.688 | −6.3 bps (−0.22) |
| **vol ×2** (the folklore) | 1.92× | **+6.12** | 0.000 | −12.6 bps (−0.26) |
| vol ×2 + drift +150 bps | 2.01× | +6.33 | 0.000 | **+137.4 bps (+3.22)** |

The null does not fire; a genuine ×2 world reads ~×1.9 at Welch *t* ≈ 6 — so if oil vol
really doubled on OPEC days, this harness would have seen it. It saw ×1.4–1.5.

## Verdict

- **Signal — MIXED** (*Real on the vol · None on the drift*). Decision-day volatility is
  genuinely elevated on all three tapes (vol multiple 1.40–1.53×, Welch *t* = 3.01–3.17,
  range *t* up to 4.80, placebo *p* ≤ 0.018) — but the signed post-decision drift is
  indistinguishable from zero everywhere (all |HAC *t*| < 1.2 over 15 horizon×tape cells).
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** The only directional rule with a pulse (day-0-sign
  continuation) never clears *t* = 2 robustly and its one borderline cell is carried by
  five 2020 events; there is no drift to harvest, gross or net. The vol elevation itself
  is not a futures edge (and options straddles around scheduled OPEC days are exactly
  where vol is already marked up).
- **"Vol doubles on OPEC day"? — BUSTED.** Elevated, yes — **1.4–1.5×**, *t* ≥ 3. Doubled,
  no: the 95% CI excludes 2.0 on every tape (upper bounds 1.67/1.89/1.85), and the
  synthetic control shows a true ×2 world would have lit this harness up at *t* ≈ 6.
